cves.title: Circutor PowerStudio SCADA Wave authentication bypass in JWT validation
cves.description: An improper JWT signature verification vulnerability in CIRCUTOR PowerStudio SCADA WAVE desktop version allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass authentication by submitting an unsigned JWT with the algorithm set to “none”. The shared JWT validation component accepts the token without verifying a cryptographic signature, allowing the attacker to impersonate another user and access protected functionality with that user's privileges.

cves.title: Everestthemes Everest Backup unauthenticated plugin activation via missing authorization
cves.product: everestthemes Everest Backup – WordPress Cloud Backup, Migr…
cves.description: The Everest Backup – WordPress Cloud Backup, Migration, Restore & Cloning Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.14 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to activate any already-installed inactive plugin on the site.

cves.title: Soledad unauthenticated code execution in more-post AJAX handler
cves.description: The Soledad theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and including, 8.7.7 The public penci_more_post_ajax AJAX action feeds infeedads[ads_code] (base64+urldecoded) to penci_safe_shortcode(), whose allowlist regex inspects only the hyphen-truncated outer shortcode name (e.g. 'adinserter') and never the nested [elementor-element k=.. data=..] tag, so do_shortcode() renders an attacker-chosen Elementor element. The rendered penci-featured-sliders widget passes its unsanitized 'style' setting to include dirname(__FILE__)."/{$style}.php", a path-traversal local file inclusion.

cves.title: GitLab path traversal in Pages exposes private CI/CD artifacts
cves.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.4 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to read private CI/CD job artifacts belonging to other projects through GitLab Pages due to improper validation of file paths.

cves.title: GitLab authorization bypass exposes metadata in package registry
cves.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.10 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read private project metadata from packages published by other projects due to incorrect authorization checks.

cves.title: GitLab cross-site scripting in Confluence integration
cves.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with owner-role permissions to execute arbitrary JavaScript in another user's browser through the Confluence integration due to improper input validation.

cves.title: GitLab authorization bypass in CI/CD pipeline jobs

cves.title: GitLab code execution in protected pipelines via scheduled policy

cves.title: GitLab authorization bypass in CI/CD pipeline execution policies

cves.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read files from a project's private repository due to missing authorization checks in snippets.

cves.title: GitLab cross-site scripting in wiki pages
cves.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of users viewing a wiki page due to improper sanitization of user input.

cves.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 8.12 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to read Git LFS objects from restricted projects due to incorrect authorization checks.

cves.title: GitLab cross-site scripting in error tracking pages
cves.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 16.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of users viewing Error Tracking pages due to improper sanitization of user input.
